_meta.description: Inputs and the results of the Python MatchScorer.score, which the Swift and Kotlin scorers must reproduce exactly, including the rounding of combined_score to three places (Python rounds the exact binary value, ties to even; truncation is wrong). NaN and infinity are spelled 'nan', 'inf' and '-inf' because JSON has no such numbers. signals holds reid, face and registered extra signals; reasoning is not covered.
